+title: 'Model: ConnectionModel session list, deleteSession, and request-scoped elicitations'
+---
+## What
+Two connection-level features in `Sources/FoundationModelsACPClient/Model/ConnectionModel+List.swift` and `ConnectionModel+Elicitation.swift`.
+
+Session list:
+- [ ] `sessions: [SessionInfo]`, `hasMoreSessions: Bool`, `refreshSessions(cwd:) async throws` (requires `canListSessions`; starts again at the first page and replaces the list), `loadMoreSessions() async throws` (sends the stored `nextCursor`, appends; no request when there is no cursor).
+- [ ] A `session_info_update` of an open session patches its item in `sessions` (the SessionModel tells the ConnectionModel through an internal callback when its `sessionInfo` changes).
+- [ ] `deleteSession(_ id:) async throws` (requires `canDeleteSessions`): if the session is open, `close` it first; then send `session/delete`; then remove it from `sessions`.
+
+Request-scoped elicitations:
+- [ ] `pendingElicitations: [PendingElicitation]` on ConnectionModel for `ElicitationRequestScope` items, keyed by the `requestId` of a client request (for example `auth/login`). Reply methods: `acceptElicitation`, `declineElicitation`, `cancelElicitation`. `ModelClient` routes request-scope items here.
+- [ ] The ConnectionModel wraps its own outbound requests that can cause elicitations (auth/login and any other alpha.7 method that has request scope) so that, when the request completes or fails, it cancels and removes the elicitations with that `requestId`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Two pages load in order, `hasMoreSessions` is false after the last page, and a refresh starts at page one.
+- [ ] A title change on an open session shows in `sessions`.
+- [ ] Delete of an open session sends close, then delete, and removes the item.
+- [ ] A request-scope elicitation is removed when its request completes.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] New `Tests/FoundationModelsACPClientTests/Model/ConnectionModelListTests.swift` and `ConnectionModelElicitationTests.swift` over `InMemoryTransport.pair()` with a scripted agent that pages and that sends a request-scope elicitation during `auth/login`.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter ConnectionModel` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
